body.definition: Admissibility of a lagged SSOE model decided in exact rational arithmetic with certified root enclosures (independent/oracle.py, python-flint 0.9.0), written from the claimset definitions without the prototype: each float of F, g, w is converted exactly to a rational; D = F - g w'; theta(B) = det(I - D L(B)) and phi(B) = det(I - F L(B)), L(B) = diag(B^{l_1}, ..., B^{l_k}), by fraction-free (Bareiss) elimination over Q[B]; G = gcd(theta, phi) exactly and theta_G = theta / G (C17: its roots are the reciprocals of the reachable and observable modes); C = the product of the cyclotomic polynomials Phi_n, n dividing a lag, each removed while it divides both theta and phi (D6 in exact arithmetic), theta_C = theta / C; R = G / C. The modes are lambda = 1/B over the roots B of a polynomial, enclosed by Arb balls of 128 bits (raised to 512 and 2048 while a modulus ball contains 1); a polynomial is admissible when every |lambda| < 1 is certified, inadmissible when some |lambda| > 1 is certified or every ambiguous root is proved to be a root of unity exp(2 pi i k/n) with Phi_n dividing the polynomial exactly (|lambda| = 1), and undecided otherwise. The largest mode modulus is the max over the roots, with certified bounds.

The largest modulus among the eigenvalues lambda of the expanded discount matrix for which the smallest singular values of [lambda I - D~; w~'] and [lambda I - D~, g~] both exceed 1e-7 (||D~||_2 + ||g~|| + ||w~||), computed with numpy by the prototype (pbh_max, claimset D5); the model forgets its initial states when it is below 1.

body.term: prototype check of the whole model
body.definition: The numpy prototype of the check of the whole model (claimset D6, D10): theta and phi by inverse DFT, division by every Phi_n, n dividing a lag, while the remainder is at most 1e-9 times the sum of absolute coefficients, and the largest mode modulus 1/min|B| over numpy roots of the cancelled MA polynomial (max_lambda_cancelled); admissible when below 1.

The Levinson-Durbin step-down (Schur-Cohn) recursion on the prototype's cancelled MA polynomial 1 + c_1 B + ... + c_n B^n: for j = n, ..., 1, kappa_j = c_j and c_i <- (c_i - kappa_j c_{j-i}) / (1 - kappa_j^2); passes (admissible) when every |kappa_j| < 1 (claimset D7; stepdown_admissible).

body.term: bisection for the largest root modulus
body.definition: Bisection on r over the step-down test applied to theta*(B/r), to a width of 1e-10, giving the largest mode modulus where the root-based value exceeds 1 (claimset D11; bisection_max_lambda).
Every eigenvalue of every diagonal block of D, one block per unique lag, has modulus below 1 (claimset D4; per_lag_max, accepted when below 1).

body.term: models of the planned tests PL1-PL6 and the examples of RN2
body.definition: The models exported by AC4 with the prototype's values (export_models.py, which draws them as confirm.py and cpp_check.py do): RN57 (set perlag: 3042 ETS(A,N,A) grid models and 200 GUM with lags (1, 12), PL1 and PL2), RN58 (set cancel: the 500 models of PL3), RN59 (set stepdown: the 575 models of PL4 and PL5, theta of degree up to 535), RN60 (set cpp: the 800 models of PL6) and RN61 (set examples: the two models of C10 and C11); 5119 models in all.

Each model's admissibility decision and largest mode modulus by a method of the study and by the exact oracle on the same model: the number of models whose decisions differ, and the largest absolute difference of the modulus on the models both find inadmissible. The PBH reference is compared with theta_G (the exact gcd), the prototype's cancellation, step-down test and bisection with theta_C (the exact cyclotomic cancellation). Models the oracle leaves undecided, and models whose certified largest modulus (theta_G or theta_C) lies within 1e-8 of 1, are left out and counted (the band of the claimset's design D26, with the oracle as reference).
Whether a method accepts a model as admissible (decaying weights: every reachable and observable mode with |lambda| < 1); compared as the number of models on which two methods differ.
